name: HorizonDefine
description: An offline definition tool for Firefox. Right-click any word on any webpage, get a definition, etymology, idioms, and an example sentence — all generated by an AI running locally in your browser. By default, no text leaves your device. Works as a companion to StartHorizon. Optional Tools mode (off by default) can fetch public dictionary references (Wiktionary, Etymonline, Merriam-Webster, Urban Dictionary) for the selected word.
